title: Xiaoyao San alleviates emotional distress - induced TNBC growth through augmenting intratumoral CD8(+)T cell infiltration mediated by Rela/NF-kB-Cxcl9 axis.
authors: Liang, Yuqi; Wu, Yingchao; Chen, Jieting; Shi, Huan; Li, Zhuang; Zeng, Juexiao; Huang, Junfeng; Zuo, Qian; Ye, Lingling; Song, Xue; Dai, Yan; Bai, Yunlong; Chen, Qianjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药逍遥散通过Rela/NF-kB-Cxcl9轴促进CD8+T细胞浸润抑制三阴性乳腺癌，虽涉及转录因子Rela与DNA结合及分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物疗效与肿瘤免疫，非TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Emotional distress (ED) is closely associated with the progression of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). Xiaoyao San (XYS), a classical Chinese herbal prescription traditionally used for mood regulation, has demonstrated potential therapeutic efficacy in emotion-related breast cancer. However, the molecular mechanisms through which XYS mitigates ED-induced TNBC (ED-TNBC) remain insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic effects of XYS on ED-TNBC and elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: A TNBC mouse model subjected to chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS) was developed to simulate ED-TNBC conditions. The therapeutic efficacy of XYS at varying doses was evaluated through behavioral assessments and tumor growth analyses. Multi-omics analyses integrating network pharmacology, bioinformatics, and molecular dynamics simulations were employed to identify principal active constituents and key molecular targets of XYS. Transcriptomic profiling, in vivo and in vitro functional assays, and molecular biology experiments were conducted to delineate the molecular mechanisms underlying XYS-mediated regulation. RESULTS: High-dose XYS markedly alleviated depression-like behaviors and suppressed ED-TNBC tumor progression, with no evident adverse effects observed. Transcriptomic and molecular analyses revealed that XYS enhanced CD8(+) T cell infiltration and cytotoxic activity through activation of Cxcl9. The active constituents of XYS were found to bind directly to the transcription factor Rela. Subsequent experiments verified that Cxcl9 secretion from TNBC cells depends on Rela activity. In addition, XYS upregulated Rela expression and promoted its nuclear translocation. CONCLUSION: XYS directly targets and activates the intratumoral Rela/NF-kappaB-Cxcl9 axis, promoting CD8(+)T cell infiltration and activation, thereby inhibiting the growth of ED-TNBS.
abstract_zh: 背景：情绪困扰（ED）与三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的进展密切相关。逍遥散（XYS）是一种传统用于情绪调节的中药复方，在情绪相关乳腺癌中显示出潜在的治疗效果。然而，XYS缓解ED诱导的TNBC（ED-TNBC）的分子机制仍未被充分表征。本研究旨在探讨XYS对ED-TNBC的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法：建立接受慢性不可预测轻度应激（CUMS）的TNBC小鼠模型，以模拟ED-TNBC条件。通过行为评估和肿瘤生长分析，评价不同剂量XYS的治疗效果。整合网络药理学、生物信息学和分子动力学模拟的多组学分析，用于识别XYS的主要活性成分和关键分子靶点。采用转录组学分析、体内外功能实验和分子生物学实验，以描绘XYS介导调控的分子机制。结果：高剂量XYS显著缓解抑郁样行为，并抑制ED-TNBC肿瘤进展，且未观察到明显不良反应。转录组学和分子分析显示，XYS通过激活Cxcl9增强CD8(+) T细胞浸润和细胞毒性活性。发现XYS的活性成分直接结合转录因子Rela。后续实验验证，TNBC细胞分泌Cxcl9依赖于Rela活性。此外，XYS上调Rela表达并促进其核转位。结论：XYS直接靶向并激活瘤内Rela/NF-kappaB-Cxcl9轴，促进CD8(+) T细胞浸润和激活，从而抑制ED-TNBC的生长。
